YOU MUST SLOWLY increase the problem size, one dimension at a time, by an increment no more than double the current to increase the FOM. If the run is successful, parse the log and get the FOM. If not, keep trying to deploy until it is fixed. Keep going until you deem optimized and return all FOMs you have parsed.
